test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Mohan said, "I shall go as soon as it is possible."

options.text: Mohan said that he will go as soon as it is possible.
Mohan said that he will go as soon as it was possible.
Mohan said that he would go as soon as it was possible.
Mohan said that he would go as soon as it is possible.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Mohan said that he would go as soon as it was possible.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I shall go" becomes "he would go"**
 
 
• Future tense "shall" is converted to "would" in reported speech.
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject.
 
 
 
• **"as soon as it is possible" becomes "as soon as it was possible"**
 
 
• Present tense "is" is converted to past tense "was".
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted to indirect speech without quotation marks.
 
• Reporting clause follows the reported speech, starting with a conjunction "that".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Mohan said that he would go as soon as it was possible.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Mohan said that he will go as soon as it is possible."
 
 
• Incorrect as future tense "will" should be "would" in reported speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Mohan said that he will go as soon as it was possible."
 
 
• Incorrect as future tense "will" should be "would" in reported speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Mohan said that he would go as soon as it is possible."
 
 
• Incorrect as present tense "is" should be "was" in reported speech.
 
 

``
